chunks: 5630 - Ya'qub ibn Yazid narrated from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak, from 'Abd Allah ibn Jabalah, from Abu Jamilah, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام:
Regarding two parents and a maternal grandmother, he said: “The mother receives one-sixth, the grandmother receives one-sixth, and what remains, which is two-thirds, belongs to the father.”

key_terms.أَبَوَيْنِ: the two parents of the deceased

ai.seo_question: How is the inheritance divided when the deceased leaves behind both parents and a maternal grandmother?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance when the deceased leaves behind both parents and a maternal grandmother. The mother receives one-sixth, the maternal grandmother receives one-sixth, and the remaining two-thirds go to the father.
